meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成 Matrix 聊天频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Matrix 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Matrix chat channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Matrix chat to your application

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会按步骤为系统接入 Matrix 聊天频道:复制适配器、注册、安装依赖、修补代码并运行构建和测试,还会引导你创建机器人账号、填写登录信息。
howto.when: 当你要添加 Matrix 频道,或正在 /setup 流程中配置该频道时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Matrix 频道接入进来
say.note: Claude 会复制适配器并运行构建测试

say.text: 配置一个 Matrix 机器人账号
say.note: 引导创建独立账号并填写凭据

say.text: 用访问令牌方式设置 Matrix 机器人
say.note: 会提示粘贴令牌和用户ID

howto.what_en: Claude adds a Matrix channel: copies the adapter, registers it, installs the pinned dep, patches ESM imports, builds/tests, and guides creating a separate bot account with credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Matrix channel, or while configuring it during the /setup flow.

say_en.text: Add a Matrix channel for me.
say_en.note: Claude will copy the adapter and run build/tests.

say_en.text: Set up a Matrix bot account.
say_en.note: Guides creating a separate account and storing credentials.

say_en.text: Configure the Matrix bot with an access token.
say_en.note: Prompts for token and user ID.
